lines.text: Since last time, how have the headaches been?
Since last time they have dropped to two a week instead of five.
Good. I'll put some needles into the upper traps today.
Hi, sorry to interrupt, your next patient is here early.
Thanks Jo, let them know I'll be about ten minutes.
Will do, see you soon, bye.
You were about to do the needles.
Yep, and after that I'll send you some exercises for your neck posture.
